name: – David McAllister – § 4, after indent 8 – Am 147
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – 2024 annual report
part_text: – Qatar’s dubious role as a negotiator in the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and the fact that neither the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) nor any other humanitarian organisation has been able to visit the hostages held by Hamas in Gaza; calls on Qatar, Türkiye and others to cease their funding of the Muslim Brotherhood and fully reject terrorism and antisemitism; calls on Qatar to cease its support for Palestinian terrorism, the Muslim Brotherhood and antisemitism through its TV network Al Jazeera; calls, furthermore, on Qatar and Egypt to ensure that the ICRC and other international medical professionals receive immediate access to the hostages in Gaza and that the hostages receive the humanitarian and medical attention needed;
